1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment is __engineered to contain a heterologous enzyme not naturally present in the compartment__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo __and comprises at least one heterologous enzyme__.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one __heterologous__ targeted enzyme.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different __heterologous__ targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 or claim 4 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a __heterologous__ Eut polypeptide.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide __from a different bacterial species than the host cell__.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides __from different bacterial species or operons__.

9. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag __for purification of the non-native compartment__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one heterologous enzyme, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide __and the at least one heterologous enzyme for catalyzing a metabolic reaction__.

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Previously presented) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a __eukaryotic organism selected from yeast or alga__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae __and the BMC polypeptides are heterologous to the yeast__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae __and the method produces a non-native compartment not naturally occurring in Saccharomyces cerevisiae__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga __and the BMC polypeptides are heterologous to the alga__.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one __heterologous__ enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product __not naturally produced by the cell__; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.

22. (Previously presented) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product.

23. (Previously presented) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

24. (Previously presented) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

25. (Previously presented) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

26. (Previously presented) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

27. (Previously presented) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of __non-native__ compartments __each comprising heterologous BMC polypeptides__.
